```{r}
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
# Create the overall dataset and then filter for 5-min/hour
Everything <- rbind(LehuaRock, PHR, FFS, RI20_1, RI20_2, RI21, Kala)

# Extract Hour, Minute, and (optionally) Date from strings like "M/D/YYYY H:MM:SS(.ms)"
Everything$Hour <- as.integer(sub("^.*\\s(\\d{1,2}):.*$", "\\1", Everything$`Start time`))
Everything$StartMinute <- as.integer(sub("^.*\\s\\d{1,2}:(\\d{2}).*$", "\\1", Everything$`Start time`))
Everything$Date <- as.Date(sub("^([0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{4}).*$", "\\1",
                               Everything$`Start time`),
                           format = "%m/%d/%Y")

# Drop the redundant lowercase 'date' column
Everything <- dplyr::select(Everything, -dplyr::any_of("date"))

# Your call factor & dictionary
Everything$Call <- factor(Everything$Call)
Everything$Call_Number <- as.numeric(Everything$Call)
Call_Dictionary <- unique(Everything[c("Call", "Call_Number")])

# Create the DF for the calls within the first 5-min/hour
firstfiveminutes <- dplyr::filter(Everything, StartMinute < 5)

# Hourly 5-min counts, preserving Day/Night
calls_hourly_raw <- firstfiveminutes %>%
  dplyr::count(Location, Date, Hour, DayNight, name = "Calls")

# Collapse to one Day/Night per hour
calls_by_hour <- calls_hourly_raw %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Location, Date, Hour) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Calls       = sum(Calls),
    day_calls   = sum(Calls[DayNight == "Day"],   na.rm = TRUE),
    night_calls = sum(Calls[DayNight == "Night"], na.rm = TRUE),
    DayNight    = dplyr::case_when(
      day_calls  > night_calls ~ "Day",
      night_calls > day_calls  ~ "Night",
      TRUE ~ ifelse(Hour >= 6 & Hour < 18, "Day", "Night")  # tie breaker
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ---- LehuaRock sunrise fix (some calls were produced minutes before/after sunrise so there is both Day/Night values ----
lehua_fix_dates <- as.Date(c(
  "2021-05-11","2021-05-12","2021-05-13",
  "2021-05-14","2021-05-15","2021-05-16"
))

calls_by_hour <- calls_by_hour %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    DayNight = dplyr::if_else(
      Location == "LehuaRock" & Hour == 6 & Date %in% lehua_fix_dates,
      "Day", as.character(DayNight)
    )
  ) %>%
  # keep one row per hour; prefer the "Day" row if both exist
  dplyr::arrange(Location, Date, Hour, dplyr::desc(DayNight == "Day")) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Location, Date, Hour, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(DayNight = factor(DayNight, levels = c("Day","Night")))
```
```{r}
# read in the SoundTrap active .csv
soundtrap_active <- read.csv("ST_active.csv", check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Remove the DataCount and .groups columns
drop_cols <- intersect(c("DataCount", ".groups"), names(soundtrap_active))
if (length(drop_cols)) soundtrap_active <- soundtrap_active[ , !(names(soundtrap_active) %in% drop_cols)]

# Make the dates work with each other (keep it simple)
soundtrap_active$Date     <- as.Date(soundtrap_active$Date, format = "%m/%d/%y")
soundtrap_active$Hour     <- as.integer(soundtrap_active$Hour)
soundtrap_active$Location <- as.character(soundtrap_active$Location)

# firstfiveminutes already has Date/Hour from earlier; just coerce types
firstfiveminutes$Date     <- as.Date(firstfiveminutes$Date)
firstfiveminutes$Hour     <- as.integer(firstfiveminutes$Hour)
firstfiveminutes$Location <- as.character(firstfiveminutes$Location)

```

```{r}
# 1) First 5-min counts per Location × Date × Hour (detections only)
data_counts_by_hour_day <- firstfiveminutes %>%
  dplyr::count(Location, Date, Hour, name = "DataCount")

# 2) Effort grid (all analyzed hours) and fill zeros
base_hours <- soundtrap_active %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Location, Date, Hour)

data_counts_by_hour_day <- base_hours %>%
  dplyr::left_join(data_counts_by_hour_day, by = c("Location","Date","Hour")) %>%
  tidyr::replace_na(list(DataCount = 0L))

# --- Manual fix for LehuaRock @ 20:00 on 2021-05-11 (logged at 20:10–20:15) ---
fix_date  <- as.Date("2021-05-11")
fix_hour  <- 20L
fix_count <- 13L

if (nrow(dplyr::filter(data_counts_by_hour_day,
                       Location == "LehuaRock", Date == fix_date, Hour == fix_hour)) > 0) {
  data_counts_by_hour_day <- data_counts_by_hour_day %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      DataCount = dplyr::if_else(Location == "LehuaRock" & Date == fix_date & Hour == fix_hour,
                                 fix_count, DataCount)
    )
} else {
  data_counts_by_hour_day <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    data_counts_by_hour_day,
    tibble::tibble(Location = "LehuaRock", Date = fix_date, Hour = fix_hour, DataCount = fix_count)
  ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Location, Date, Hour)
}

# confirm the override is in place
data_counts_by_hour_day %>%
  dplyr::filter(Location == "LehuaRock", Date == fix_date, Hour == fix_hour) %>%
  print()

# --- Keep calls_by_hour consistent with the manual fix (so plots/stats match) ---
fix_dn <- ifelse(fix_hour >= 6 & fix_hour < 18, "Day", "Night")  # 20:00 => Night
km <- (calls_by_hour$Location == "LehuaRock" &
       calls_by_hour$Date     == fix_date     &
       calls_by_hour$Hour     == fix_hour)

if (any(km)) {
  calls_by_hour$Calls[km]        <- fix_count
  calls_by_hour$day_calls[km]    <- ifelse(fix_dn == "Day",   fix_count, 0L)
  calls_by_hour$night_calls[km]  <- ifelse(fix_dn == "Night", fix_count, 0L)
  calls_by_hour$DayNight[km]     <- fix_dn
} else {
  calls_by_hour <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    calls_by_hour,
    tibble::tibble(
      Location    = "LehuaRock",
      Date        = fix_date,
      Hour        = fix_hour,
      Calls       = fix_count,
      day_calls   = ifelse(fix_dn == "Day",   fix_count, 0L),
      night_calls = ifelse(fix_dn == "Night", fix_count, 0L),
      DayNight    = fix_dn
    )
  )
}

# 3) Quick look at biggest 5-min counts (still effort-based)
data_counts_by_hour_day %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(DataCount)) %>%
  head(25)

# 4) Hours & minutes analyzed per deployment (effort-based)
hours_per_deployment <- base_hours %>%
  dplyr::count(Location, name = "Total_Hours")

minutes_per_deployment <- hours_per_deployment %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Total_Minutes = Total_Hours * 5)

print(minutes_per_deployment, n = nrow(minutes_per_deployment))

# 5) POOLED mean calls by hour (across all sites; effort-based)
average_calls_per_hour <- aggregate(DataCount ~ Hour, mean, data = data_counts_by_hour_day) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Hour)
print(average_calls_per_hour, row.names = FALSE)

# 6) BY-SITE mean calls by hour (effort-based)
average_calls_per_hour_location <- data_counts_by_hour_day %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Location, Hour) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(AverageDataCount = mean(DataCount), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Location, Hour)
print(average_calls_per_hour_location, n = 100)

# 6b) (optional) BY-SITE mean ± SE and sample size (effort-based) for Figure 5
avg_by_site_hour <- data_counts_by_hour_day %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Location, Hour) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_5min = mean(DataCount),
    se_5min   = sd(DataCount) / sqrt(dplyr::n()),
    n_hours   = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

avg_by_site_hour %>% dplyr::arrange(Location, Hour) %>% print(n = 200)
```

```{r}
# === Figure 5: Mean (±SE) calls in the first 5 minutes by hour & site ===

# Colors that match your map figure / Table 1
cbPalette <- c("#6BD3FF", "#70FB76", "#008B8D", "#FF726C", "#490F8D", "#9131FF", "#D67DFF")

# Ensure consistent Location ordering
loc_levels <- c("FFS","Kala","LehuaRock","PHR","RI21","RI20_1","RI20_2")
loc_levels <- loc_levels[loc_levels %in% unique(avg_by_site_hour$Location)]
avg_by_site_hour$Location <- factor(avg_by_site_hour$Location, levels = loc_levels)

# Distinct shapes for each location (will be trimmed to #levels)
shape_values <- c(18, 3, 16, 7, 17, 19, 15)[seq_along(loc_levels)]
pal <- cbPalette[seq_along(loc_levels)]

g <- ggplot(
  avg_by_site_hour,
  aes(x = Hour, y = mean_5min, color = Location, shape = Location)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_5min - se_5min, ymax = mean_5min + se_5min),
                width = 0.20, linewidth = 0.35) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "Mean monk seal calls in first 5 minutes of each hour",
    y = "Mean calls per 5-min window",
    x = "Hour (HST)"

  scale_colour_manual(values = pal) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = shape_values) +

  breaks = c(0, 6, 12, 18, 24),
  labels = c("0", "6", "12", "18", "0"),
  limits = c(-1.0, 24.0),   # adds ~½ hour of space on both ends
  expand = c(0, 0)
) +
  scale_y_continuous(
  breaks = seq(0, 50, 10),
  limits = c(-1.5, 58),
  expand = c(0, 0)
)

# Preview first
```

```{r}
# --- Figure 6: Average calls (first 5 minutes) by hour, faceted by call type ---

# 1) Top call types
selected_calls <- c("Croak", "Growl", "Moan", "Whoop")

# 2) Counts per Location × Date × Hour × Call from first 5 minutes
counts_per_day <- firstfiveminutes %>%
  dplyr::filter(Call %in% selected_calls) %>%
  dplyr::count(Location, Date, Hour, Call, name = "Calls")

# 3) Effort grid (all analyzed hours) × call types → fill missing with 0, then average
#    (requires base_hours built earlier from soundtrap_active)
avg_calltype_by_hour <- base_hours %>%
  tidyr::crossing(Call = selected_calls) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(counts_per_day, by = c("Location","Date","Hour","Call")) %>%
  tidyr::replace_na(list(Calls = 0L)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Location, Hour, Call) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_calls_5min = mean(Calls),
    se_calls_5min   = sd(Calls) / sqrt(dplyr::n()),
    n_hours         = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 4) Keep only the sites we want (drop RI20_1) and set factor orders
loc_levels <- c("FFS","Kala","LehuaRock","PHR","RI21","RI20_2")

plot_df <- avg_calltype_by_hour %>%
  dplyr::filter(Location %in% loc_levels,
                Call %in% selected_calls) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Location = factor(Location, levels = loc_levels),
    Call     = factor(Call, levels = selected_calls),
    Hour     = as.numeric(Hour)   # ensure numeric for axis padding
  )

  "FFS"="#6BD3FF","PHR"="#FF726C","LehuaRock"="#008B8D",
  "RI20_2"="#D67DFF","RI21"="#490F8D","Kala"="#70FB76"
)[loc_levels]
```

```{r}
# --- Day vs Night Statistical Test ------------------------------------
# Uses analyzed hours (base_hours) + first-5-min counts with zeros (data_counts_by_hour_day)
# and Day/Night labels from calls_by_hour (fallback: 06:00–17:59 = Day).

# 1) One row per analyzed hour with DN + Calls (zeros included)
dn_df <- base_hours %>%
  left_join(select(calls_by_hour, Location, Date, Hour, DayNight),
            by = c("Location","Date","Hour")) %>%
  mutate(
    DayNight = if_else(is.na(DayNight),
                       if_else(Hour >= 6 & Hour < 18, "Day", "Night"),
                       DayNight),
    DayNight = factor(DayNight, levels = c("Day","Night"))
  ) %>%
  left_join(select(data_counts_by_hour_day, Location, Date, Hour, DataCount),
            by = c("Location","Date","Hour")) %>%
  mutate(Calls = coalesce(DataCount, 0L)) %>%
  select(Location, Date, Hour, DayNight, Calls)

# 2) Per-site Day vs Night averages
dn_avg <- dn_df %>%
  group_by(Location, DayNight) %>%
  summarise(
    n_hours    = n(),
    mean_calls = mean(Calls),
    se_calls   = sd(Calls) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Location, DayNight)

print(dn_avg, n = 50)

# 3) Wilcoxon test (Night vs Day) per site + BH adjust
dn_tests <- dn_df %>%
  group_by(Location) %>%
  summarise(
    p = {
      x <- Calls[DayNight == "Day"]; y <- Calls[DayNight == "Night"]
      if (length(x) > 0 && length(y) > 0 && length(unique(c(x,y))) > 1)
        wilcox.test(x, y, exact = FALSE)$p.value
      else NA_real_
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"))

print(dn_tests)

# 4) Combine means + p-values in one table
dn_results <- dn_avg %>%
  select(Location, DayNight, mean_calls, se_calls, n_hours) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = DayNight,
              values_from = c(mean_calls, se_calls, n_hours)) %>%
  mutate(
    diff_mean  = mean_calls_Day - mean_calls_Night,
    ratio_mean = mean_calls_Night / pmax(mean_calls_Day, 1e-9)
  ) %>%
  left_join(dn_tests, by = "Location") %>%
  arrange(Location)

print(dn_results, n = 50)
```

```{r}
# =========================

# A) Totals by site (EFFORT-BASED, uses the per-hour 5-min counts incl. any manual fixes)
counts_no_fix <- firstfiveminutes %>%
  dplyr::count(Location, Date, Hour, name = "DataCount")

dc_by_hour_no_fix <- base_hours %>%
  dplyr::left_join(counts_no_fix, by = c("Location","Date","Hour")) %>%
  tidyr::replace_na(list(DataCount = 0L))

# A) Totals by site (effort-based, NO manual fix)
totals_5min_by_site_no_fix <- dc_by_hour_no_fix %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Location) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Total_calls_5min = sum(DataCount),   # total calls in first 5 min of analyzed hours
    n_hours          = dplyr::n(),       # hours analyzed for diel patterns
    mean_per_hour    = mean(DataCount),  # mean calls per 5-min window
    se_per_hour      = sd(DataCount) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Location)

print(totals_5min_by_site_no_fix, n = Inf)

# B) Totals by call type (RAW first-5-min annotations; mirrors what you actually labeled)
totals_by_call <- firstfiveminutes %>%
  dplyr::count(Call, name = "Total") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Prop = Total / sum(Total)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(Total))

print(totals_by_call, n = Inf)

# Table 3: calls by type × site (ALL annotated calls in Everything)

# drop non-discrete types (set to character(0) to keep everything)
drop_calls <- c("Hum","Grunt")

site_levels <- sort(unique(Everything$Location))  # use whatever sites are in your data

tbl3 <- Everything %>%
  filter(!is.na(Call), !(Call %in% drop_calls)) %>%   # all calls (no 0–4 min filter)
  count(Call, Location, name = "n") %>%               # counts per call × site
  complete(Call, Location = site_levels, fill = list(n = 0L)) %>%  # fill absent combos with 0
  pivot_wider(names_from = Location, values_from = n) %>%
  # add row totals and percent of grand total
  mutate(Total = rowSums(across(-Call))) %>%
  arrange(desc(Total))

grand_total <- sum(tbl3$Total)

tbl3 <- tbl3 %>%
  mutate(`Percent of total` = ifelse(Total / grand_total < 0.001, "--",
                                     sprintf("%.1f", 100 * Total / grand_total)))

print(tbl3, n = Inf)
```
